audit_metadata.title: OPB Complete Signal Lifecycle + Target / Expiry Feasibility Audit
audit_metadata.audit_type: STRICT READ-ONLY CODE + CONFIG + TEST + HISTORICAL-EVIDENCE AUDIT

primary_questions_assessment.1_why_generated: Symbol composite score across 16 technical strategies meets or exceeds category threshold
primary_questions_assessment.2_eligibility_criteria: Active universe symbol, session calendar open, 1m/5m/15m data fresh, long-only cash check, D20-A options gate (breakout>0 & vol>0), D20-B session dedup for index
primary_questions_assessment.3_strength_criteria: Score >= category threshold (70-80), tier in ('STRONG', 'MODERATE'), ML probability >= 0.65 or 0.50 uncalibrated neutral fallback in paper/signal-only mode
primary_questions_assessment.4_entry_price: Cash equity / index spot LTP from the latest bar (signal.price). Futures also uses cash spot price
primary_questions_assessment.5_entry_range: ABSENT - Single scalar point price only
primary_questions_assessment.6_start_from: ABSENT - Only 'Valid From' which is the raw generation timestamp formatted to IST
primary_questions_assessment.7_entry_by: ABSENT - No entry window or entry deadline exists; only holding exit time is displayed
primary_questions_assessment.8_t1: +4.0% for CALL/BUY, -4.0% for PUT/SELL from entry price
primary_questions_assessment.9_t2: +8.0% for CALL/BUY, -8.0% for PUT/SELL from entry price
primary_questions_assessment.10_sl: -3.0% for CALL/BUY, +3.0% for PUT/SELL from entry price
primary_questions_assessment.12_expiry_determination: Category rule in core/signals/signal_outcome_tracker.py: Options = same day 15:30 IST; Equities/Futures = 5 trading days 15:30 IST
primary_questions_assessment.13_max_holding_time: Intraday: remaining session hours (1 to 6.25 hrs); Swing: 5 trading days
primary_questions_assessment.14_expiry_before_target_reachable: YES - High frequency. For Index Options, Nifty requires 1,008 pt move (+4%) intraday against 180 pt ATR. For Stock Options, stock requires +4% intraday move often in <2 hours
primary_questions_assessment.15_expected_move_estimation: NO - Neither IV expected move nor intraday remaining expected move is calculated
primary_questions_assessment.16_target_distance_vs_volatility: NO - Fixed percentage targets are decoupled from instrument ATR and volatility
primary_questions_assessment.17_time_to_target_estimation: NO - No velocity, drift, or duration model exists
primary_questions_assessment.18_probability_t1_before_sl: NO - p_t1 is None / UNCALIBRATED in prediction snapshots; no probability gate exists
primary_questions_assessment.21_entry_vs_position_expiry_distinction: NO - Entry validity window is absent; conflated with holding horizon
primary_questions_assessment.22_validity_vs_observation_lifetime_dist: NO - Conflated under single holding horizon
primary_questions_assessment.23_category_specific_target_logic: NO - All categories share identical +4% T1, +8% T2, -3% SL
primary_questions_assessment.24_category_specific_expiry_logic: YES - Intraday for Options vs 5 days for Swing/Futures
primary_questions_assessment.25_instrument_specific_volatility: NO - Fixed percentage ignores symbol beta, ATR, and IV
primary_questions_assessment.26_option_greeks_iv_theta_usage: NO - Zero Greeks used in option pricing, strike selection, or target calculation
primary_questions_assessment.27_monitoring_vs_displayed_target_consis: YES - SignalOutcomeTracker evaluates exact target_1, target_2, and stop_loss stored at signal generation

EQUITY_SWING_DELIVERY.instrument_nature: Cash equity listed shares (non-F&O or F&O equity with delivery series)
EQUITY_SWING_DELIVERY.feasibility_assessment: Plausible for 5-day swing horizon on volatile equities

STOCK_OPTIONS.instrument_nature: F&O listed stocks classified as STOCK_OPTIONS by classify_instrument_market
STOCK_OPTIONS.entry_basis: CASH UNDERLYING SPOT LTP (NOT an option premium)
STOCK_OPTIONS.target_basis: Underlying Cash Stock Price (Zero option strike/premium model)
STOCK_OPTIONS.feasibility_assessment: Severely Infeasible. Underlying moving 4-8% intraday is rare; option premium dynamics completely unmodeled

INDEX_OPTIONS.instrument_nature: Benchmark Indices (NIFTY, BANKNIFTY, FINNIFTY, MIDCPNIFTY, SENSEX, BANKEX)
INDEX_OPTIONS.entry_basis: CASH INDEX SPOT VALUE (e.g. NIFTY 25,200, NOT option premium)
INDEX_OPTIONS.t1: +4.0% (CALL) / -4.0% (PUT) on index spot (+1,008 pts on NIFTY)
INDEX_OPTIONS.t2: +8.0% (CALL) / -8.0% (PUT) on index spot (+2,016 pts on NIFTY)
INDEX_OPTIONS.sl: -3.0% (CALL) / +3.0% (PUT) on index spot (-756 pts on NIFTY)
INDEX_OPTIONS.feasibility_assessment: Structurally Impossible on normal trading days. Daily Nifty range is ~180 pts (0.7%); T1 requires 1,008 pts (5.6x daily range)

FUTURES.entry_basis: CASH SPOT LTP of underlying at generation time
FUTURES.target_basis: Cash spot price at generation; monitored against resolved futures prices
FUTURES.feasibility_assessment: Moderate. Basis risk exists between cash spot entry and futures market price

lifecycle_gaps.gap_name: LIFECYCLE DESIGN GAP: Missing Entry Validity Window
lifecycle_gaps.impact: Signals have no entry expiration; stale signals remain actionable indefinitely until position expiry

lifecycle_gaps.gap_name: TARGET FEASIBILITY GAP: Structurally Impossible Index Option Targets
lifecycle_gaps.impact: Index options demand 4.0% (+1,000 pt) moves within intraday hours, causing near-universal timeout

lifecycle_gaps.gap_name: INSTRUMENT MISMATCH GAP: Stock Options Price & Target on Cash Spot
lifecycle_gaps.impact: Stock options emit cash equity price as entry and 4% spot move as target with zero strike, premium, or Greeks
ML win probability defaults to 0.50 without calibrated target-reach probability models (p_t1, p_t2, p_sl are null)

lifecycle_gaps.gap_name: EXPIRY GAP: Conflation of Signal Validity and Holding Horizon
lifecycle_gaps.impact: Signal validity and holding horizon are merged into valid_until; no trade entry invalidation exists

lifecycle_gaps.gap_name: FUTURES GENERATION BASIS GAP: Entry calculated from Cash Spot
lifecycle_gaps.impact: Futures signals use cash spot LTP for entry, SL, and targets rather than contract market LTP at signal time

executive_answers.1_architecture_fundamentally_sound: PARTIAL - Pipeline plumbing, deduplication, governance, and audit logging are highly mature, but pricing and target calculations are fundamentally flawed for derivatives
executive_answers.2_optimization_goal: SIGNAL GENERATION - The system is heavily optimized to generate and broadcast signals, NOT for realistic target achievement
executive_answers.3_category_specific_targets: NO - All 4 categories use identical hardcoded +4% T1, +8% T2, -3% SL
executive_answers.4_entry_validity_window: NO - Completely absent across all categories
executive_answers.6_validated_probability_gate: NO - NO VALIDATED TARGET-PROBABILITY DELIVERY GATE
executive_answers.7_unrealistic_signals_emitted: YES - Specifically for Index Options and Stock Options where 4-8% moves cannot occur before 15:30 IST
executive_answers.8_stale_late_entry_emitted: YES - Stale setups are not blocked because there is no entry deadline or setup invalidation check
executive_answers.9_target_monitoring_consistency: YES - The exact persisted targets and stop-losses are monitored
10_top_3_required_changes: Implement category-appropriate target models: index options (0.8% - 1.2% or ATR-based), stock options (actual premium/strike model)
Establish an Entry Validity Window (e.g. 5-15 mins) distinct from the Position Holding Horizon
Implement a Pre-Delivery Target Feasibility Gate comparing target distance to remaining session expected move
